dashboard.label: LLM Observability - LangChain RAG
dashboard.description: Supervision des appels LLM, consommation de tokens et latence

search.query: index=llm_observability sourcetype=langchain_events event_type=query | dedup model_name | table model_name

index=llm_observability sourcetype=langchain_events event_type=query model_name=$model_filter$ | timechart span=1h sum(prompt_tokens) as "Prompt" sum(completion_tokens) as "Completion" sum(total_tokens) as "Total"
index=llm_observability sourcetype=langchain_events event_type=query model_name=$model_filter$ | timechart span=1h avg(latency_ms) as "Latence moyenne" p95(latency_ms) as "P95"
index=llm_observability sourcetype=langchain_events | stats count(eval(status="error")) as errors count as total | eval error_rate=round(errors/total*100, 2) | fields error_rate
index=llm_observability sourcetype=langchain_events event_type=error | timechart span=1h count as "Erreurs"

index=llm_observability sourcetype=langchain_events event_type=query model_name=$model_filter$ | stats count avg(latency_ms) as avg_latency avg(total_tokens) as avg_tokens by query_text | sort - count | head 20 | rename query_text as "Requete" count as "Occurrences" avg_latency as "Latence moy. (ms)" avg_tokens as "Tokens moy." | fieldformat "Latence moy. (ms)"=round('Latence moy. (ms)', 1) | fieldformat "Tokens moy."=round('Tokens moy.', 0)
index=llm_observability sourcetype=langchain_events event_type=query | stats count by model_name
